speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (likely 21-hydroxylase deficiency).

The findings of virilization (clitoromegaly, hirsutism, severe acne) combined with delayed menarche and a history of fractures suggest a severe enzymatic block leading to adrenal crisis and bone loss; please confirm your current electrolytes and 17-hydroxyprogesterone levels immediately.
